newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, demand weak.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, demand weak.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in thin late trading after early falls as buyers stayed sidelined waiting for fresh leads, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,420-25 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from last Friday's closing of 1,435-40 rupiah. Crude palm oil was offered at 1,220 rupiah/kg in Medan.
"The market was rather quiet towards the end because of falls in Malaysia," one trader said.
"But I think olein prices cannot go down much more because of relatively high crude palm oil prices," he said. Traders said crude palm oil prices have been high due to European demand.
Traders said they were expecting a sharp increase in the December export tax on crude palm oil, which is expected to be announced by the finance ministry this week.
They said they expected the tax to rise to $42-$43/tonne this month from $28 in November.
Data from Belawan Port showed that the MV Lancer will leave the North Sumatran port on Monday with 15,675 tonnes of crude palm oil for Port Klang, Malaysia.
The MT Penta-lV will also leave on Monday for Batam island near Singapore with 2,000 tonnes of crude palm oil.
